description: pcivil.icgc.cat: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by pcivil.icgc.cat. Coverage: the area served by pcivil.icgc.cat. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cobertura teórica de las sirenas de presa; Elementos vulnerables de la presa de Albagés, hipótesis H2, rotura de ; Zonas inundables de la presa de Baserca, hipótesis H2, rotura de presa; Elementos vulnerables de la presa de Baserca, hipótesis H2, rotura de . Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://governobert.gencat.cat/ca/dades_obertes/llicencia-oberta-informacio-catalunya/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
